models.source: Microchip MCP6001/2/4 datasheet (DS21733): IQ 100 µA typ / 170 µA max per amplifier (dual = 2×); output load current is not included.
Microchip MCP3201 datasheet (DS21290): IDD ≈ 300 µA typ / 500 µA max while converting at 5 V; IREF ≈ 150 µA during conversion.

LM4040 shunt reference: the DC power sim has no zener element, so the cathode is a constant sink at a typical bias point (0.7 mA, between the 60–75 µA minimum and 15 mA maximum of TI SNOS633). The reference VOLTAGE and the real cathode current come from pcbpilot sim analog (spice-models/analog-models.json).

assumptions: DC operating point (MNA + Newton-Raphson): capacitors open, inductors = DCR, switching regulators averaged by power balance; not a transient simulation
IC signal pins are high-impedance (no DC drive) unless a GPIO drives an LED network
loads are constant-current above a knee voltage and resistive below it (unpowered rails draw nothing)
J2: input source +5V = 5.00 V (net name) with 0.02 Ω series resistance

steps.title: 目检
steps.action: 放大镜/AOI 检查极性与方向件：U1, U2, U3；细间距与 EP 器件检查连锡、立碑、少锡
steps.expect: 极性/1 脚全部与丝印一致，无连锡
steps.ifFail: 返修后重新目检，禁止带缺陷上电

steps.title: 断电短路检查
steps.action: 万用表欧姆档，红表笔接各电源轨、黑表笔接 GND（见下表）
steps.expect: 每条轨 > 100 Ω，数值与下表已知路径同量级
steps.ifFail: < 10 Ω：按电源树从源头逐段断开（拆 0 Ω/电感/二极管）定位短路

steps.title: 限流上电
steps.action: 可调电源接其中一路输入（J2(+5V)，逐路验证），限流 50 mA（1.5× 典型），电压从 0 缓升到标称
steps.expect: 空载/典型电流 ≈ 1.35 mA（仿真 typical），无器件发热
steps.ifFail: 电流顶到限流：立即断电，回到第 2 步；局部发热用热像/手触定位

steps.title: 测量各电源轨
steps.action: 按 §8 测试点计划逐条测量，从上游到下游：+5V → VREF

steps.title: 功能与接口
steps.action: 按 §8 测接口枚举、复位/启动键、指示灯
steps.ifFail: 接口失败先查差分对焊接与 CC/上下拉电阻值

steps.title: 带载 / 峰值
steps.action: 运行峰值负载固件（如射频发射），记录输入电流与各轨最低电压
steps.expect: 输入电流 ≈ 1.69 mA（仿真峰值场景），各轨不跌出容差
steps.ifFail: 跌落：检查 IR 压降路径（§6）与输入源能力
